items.event: DP World Tour Championship, Dubai – final round
items.line: Tyrrell Hatton (-9) leads Victor Perez (-8) by one going into Sunday. Rory McIlroy and Race to Dubai leader Eugenio Chacarra are level at -5, so the round also decides the season title: McIlroy is chasing an eighth Order of Merit, which would equal Montgomerie's record.
items.whenJst: Sun Nov 15 · 17:00 JST (leaders tee off; McIlroy 16:30)

items.event: ATP Finals, Turin – opening day: Zverev vs Jodar
items.line: The season finale starts without defending champion Jannik Sinner, who is out with a knee injury. Top seed Alexander Zverev opens the McEnroe Group against Rafael Jodar, and Ben Shelton plays Arthur Fils in the night session (Mon 04:30 JST).
